topic.title: 3 Common Mistakes Beginner Forex Traders Make

research.summary: Beginner forex traders can face avoidable problems when they trade without a defined plan, misunderstand risk, or treat market predictions as guarantees.
key_points: Trading without a defined plan can make decisions inconsistent.
Risk management matters because individual forex trades can result in losses.
Past price movement does not guarantee future results.
A trading idea is a possibility, not a guaranteed outcome.
Educational content should not be presented as personalized financial advice.

notes: Educational claims should be checked against the listed sources.
Do not publish unverified claims as confirmed facts.
Do not describe market outcomes as guaranteed.

script.hook: 3 common mistakes beginner forex traders should understand.
